summary: One Latur MVP tested end-to-end. Backend: all 13 API tests pass (categories, discover, banners, stores, store-by-id, store products, products with category filter, buy-again, product-by-id, 404 handling). No _id leakage. Frontend: Home renders Discover chip row (8 chips), category grid (8), banners (3), buy-again carousel, stores rail (3), Fresh Picks grid (21 products). Store /store/s1 shows exactly 4 media tiles in 2x2 grid with 2 VIDEO badges + 2 images and centered overlapping circular logo, store name Latur Fresh Mart, tags, rating, and horizontal category chip filter. Product /product/p1 shows hero, price ₹25, MRP ₹40 strikethrough, Save ₹15 pill, features list, and sticky Add-to-Cart converting to stepper. Category /category/c1 pastel green header with 4 filtered products. Cart tab shows items, bill breakdown, discount, delivery fee, grand total and Checkout button. Checkout clears cart (badge disappears, empty state renders). Tab navigation (Home/Categories/Cart/Account) and back navigation work correctly. Cart badge on tab bar updates live. Minor design issue: store screen category chips render raw IDs (C1..C7) instead of readable names. Deprecated packages detected: none blocking, but react-native shadow* style props are deprecated (should use boxShadow on web).

ui_bugs.issue: Chips render raw category_id in uppercase (e.g. C1, C2) instead of resolving to category names like 'Fruits & Veggies'. Users cannot understand what each chip filters. Reference: /app/frontend/app/store/[id].tsx:167 (c.toUpperCase()).

issues: Free-delivery unlock hint is not shown when subtotal < ₹199. Consider adding a 'Add ₹X more for FREE delivery' progress banner (spec says free delivery unlocks over ₹199).
Category filter chips show raw uppercase IDs (C1, C2) - poor UX, should show category names.

react_native_issues.issue: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated in RN web build. Warnings printed on every screen load. Use 'boxShadow' or Platform-specific shadow tokens. Reference: /app/frontend/app/store/[id].tsx:205 and /app/frontend/app/store/[id].tsx:220 (shadowColor/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius/shadowOffset).

action_items: Resolve store screen category chip labels: map category_id to Category.name using categories list rather than displaying raw ID in uppercase.
Add free-delivery progress hint on cart screen when subtotal < ₹199 (e.g. 'Add ₹X more for FREE delivery') to fulfill spec requirement.
Migrate deprecated shadow* style props to boxShadow (or Platform.select) to remove console warnings on web/newer RN versions.
Consider surfacing an explicit 'Order placed successfully' toast/screen before auto-clearing cart (currently cart clears and returns to empty state, no visible success confirmation).
critical_code_review_comments: frontend/.env exposes EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (correct for Expo public envs). System prompt references EXPO_BACKEND_URL but Expo requires EXPO_PUBLIC_ prefix - current usage in src/api.ts is correct.
server.py: seed data is in-memory (MongoDB client created but unused). Acceptable for MVP per spec; document that persistence layer is not yet wired.
product-card.tsx: onPress uses e.stopPropagation?.() to prevent parent Pressable navigation - correct pattern, verified working.
store/[id].tsx MediaTile: useVideoPlayer is called for every tile including images with empty URL - functional but wasteful. Consider only initializing player for video tiles.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created; backend serves in-memory sample data as designed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend seed data lives in server.py (in-memory). Store s1 media MUST remain exactly 2 videos + 2 images. Discover chips MUST include 8 labels: Trending, New, Fresh, Bestseller, Under ₹99, Local, Organic, Combo. Frontend uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL). Cart badge testID 'cart-badge' appears inside tab-cart icon - use .first when locating.
rca_of_issue: N/A - no bugs blocking user flows.
